players.name: Toni Kroos
players.note: A World Cup winner in his first Madrid season, remade from the attacking midfielder of the Bayern rows into the deep controller — the passing range was already the best in the league.

players.name: Cristiano Ronaldo
players.note: Forty-eight league goals, the Pichichi and the European Golden Shoe at twenty-nine: the statistical peak of his career and the equal of the 2007/08 season rated 96.

players.name: Marcelo
players.note: At twenty-six, in the conversation for the best attacking full back in the world — level with Dani Alves 2009/10 rather than above him.

players.name: Iker Casillas
players.note: Thirty-three and visibly past the 2009/10 peak — still an elite goalkeeper, but a season of errors that cost him the shirt the following summer.

players.name: Gareth Bale
players.note: Thirteen league goals from the left in a season spent being whistled at the Bernabéu; elite, a little short of the 2012/13 and 2013/14 peak.

players.name: Sergio Ramos
players.note: By twenty-eight no longer the converted full back of the 2009/10 row but a world-class centre-back and Spain’s leader.

players.name: Pepe
players.note: A point above the 2009/10 row, which covers nine injury-hit games at twenty-six; Pepe genuinely peaked around thirty, and 2013/14 and 2014/15 were his two best seasons.

players.name: Luka Modrić
players.note: A thigh injury cost him half the season; when he played, Madrid were a different side. World class, a rung below Xavi at his peak.

players.name: Álvaro Arbeloa
players.note: Thirty-one and down to twelve starts; the honest, limited full back of the Liverpool rows with the legs gone.

players.name: Keylor Navas
players.note: Rated on the keeper, not the minutes: he arrived off an outstanding Levante season and World Cup and spent the league year behind Casillas. Close-range reaction saving is what he does, so Reflexes rather than ShotStopper.

players.name: Fábio Coentrão
players.note: Portugal’s first-choice left-back when fit, which by twenty-six he increasingly was not.

players.name: Jesé
players.note: Back from the cruciate injury that took the best of him; the talent was plain, the player never the same.

players.name: Sami Khedira
players.note: Three starts in an injury-wrecked final season in Madrid; the player, not the minutes.
